title: Agent skills need receipts
question: What changes when the same coding agent gets no skill, a short checklist, or the complete skill?
summary: Agent Skill Lab will compare repeated runs of one fixed repository task, then publish the trajectory evidence behind the verdict.

task.description: Each result uses one bounded repository task with a real failure or behavior change and a clean starting revision.
success_criteria: The requested behavior passes deterministic end-to-end and focused tests.
The patch avoids unrelated product or repository changes.
The final explanation matches the observable implementation and test evidence.
task.evaluation_method: Score every run against the same predeclared success and quality rubric, then compare outcomes and observable execution traces.

permissions: The same sandbox and tool permissions in every condition

conditions.label: No skill
conditions.setup: The agent receives the task and normal harness instructions only.

conditions.label: Minimal instructions
conditions.setup: The agent also receives a short checklist that captures the skill's main behavioral claim.

conditions.label: Full skill
conditions.setup: The agent receives the complete skill at one pinned revision.

held_constant: Model, version, reasoning effort, and harness
Repository fixture, starting revision, task, and success criteria
Tool permissions, timeout, token ceiling, and cost ceiling
Number of independent runs in each condition

measures.label: Task success
measures.description: Whether the run clears every predeclared success criterion.

measures.label: Final quality
measures.description: A zero-to-100 score from the same disclosed rubric for every run.

measures.label: Trajectory
measures.description: Planning, tool use, recovery events, interventions, and unnecessary actions.

measures.label: Efficiency
measures.description: Elapsed time, input and output tokens, tool calls, and estimated cost.

publication_rule: No verdict appears until all nine runs, the scoring receipts, and the publication-safe artifacts pass review.
limitations: Three runs per condition expose obvious variance but cannot establish a universal ranking.
Each result applies to its pinned task, model, harness, and skill revision.
Published traces show observable actions and outputs, not hidden model reasoning.
